comments.text:
In Germany, we have independent agencies that closely monitor and document problems with German automakers. 
And overall, the situation regarding total breakdowns and malfunctions has improved significantly. The average rate of total breakdowns has dropped from 6% to 2.8% by new cars. 
So it’s much less likely that you’ll buy a new car and get stranded in it. 
What has increased, however, are problems related to the infotainment system. But these systems haven’t been around for very long, and the issues can usually be resolved with updates. The blonde woman with the G-Class is experiencing normal wear and tear on her car. You should change the oil in any car every 10,000 kilometers, depending on your driving style. And if u dont know that 2,5t car with over 400hsp needs crazy good brakes, u must be retarded. 
The main problem for the US is that u cant buy from the OEMs directly. Every car in Germany has at least a two year warranty without any cost for u. And u dont have to go to Mercedes or VW for repairs u can go to independent car shops and buy ur owen parts.
